title.ja: 図1-1 ゴキゲン中飛車の出だし
title.en: Figure 1-1: Opening of Gokigen Central Rook

explain.ja: テーマ図は、ゴキゲン中飛車の出だしです。序盤の早い段階で5筋の歩を突き、中飛車を目指します。ゴキゲン中飛車は基本的に後手番で使う戦法なので、今回は後手の立場で解説します。なお、盤面は後手側から見えるよう反転しています。
explain.en: The theme diagram shows the opening of Gokigen Central Rook. Early on, the 5th-file pawn is pushed, aiming for a Central Rook. Gokigen Central Rook is basically played as White, so this explanation takes White's point of view. The board is flipped accordingly.

section.ja: ゴキゲン中飛車は後手番の戦法
section.en: Gokigen Central Rook is a strategy for White

title.ja: 図1-2 飛車を5筋に振って中飛車に
title.en: Figure 1-2: Swing the rook to the 5th file for Central Rook

explain.ja: こちらは飛車を5筋に振って、中飛車の構えを取ります。よくある振り飛車の出だしでは、△4四歩などとして角道を止めるのが基本ですが、角道を止めずに飛車を振るのがゴキゲン中飛車です。
explain.en: We swing the rook to the 5th file to form the Central Rook setup. In typical Ranging Rook openings, the basic move is to close the bishop diagonal with something like △4四歩, but Gokigen Central Rook swings the rook without closing the bishop diagonal.

section.ja: ゴキゲン中飛車は後手番の戦法
section.en: Gokigen Central Rook is a strategy for White

title.ja: 図1-3 5筋の歩で角道を止める
title.en: Figure 1-3: Stop the bishop diagonal with the 5th-file pawn

explain.ja: ゴキゲン中飛車では、5五の歩で角道を止めるのが基本の形です。やや不安定に見えますが、△5六歩を突くことで飛車と角をまとめてさばいていけます。この形なら角交換も防げます。
explain.en: In Gokigen Central Rook, the basic setup is to block the bishop diagonal with a pawn on 5五. It can look a little unstable, but △5六歩 lets you free both your rook and bishop at once, and it also prevents a bishop exchange.

section.ja: 5五の歩で角道を止めるのがポイント
section.en: Key point: block the bishop line with the 5五 pawn

title.ja: 図1-4 ゴキゲン中飛車の基本形
title.en: Figure 1-4: Basic form of Gokigen Central Rook

explain.ja: 角を3三に上がって相手の飛車からの攻めを防ぎます。これでゴキゲン中飛車の基本形が完成です。ここから美濃囲いに組み、銀を前に繰り出して攻めるのが定跡的な方針です。3三角で飛車の攻めを防ぐ点は、ほかの振り飛車と同じです。基本形に至るまでの細かい変化を知らないと序盤で不利になるので、しっかり覚えましょう。
explain.en: Move the bishop up to 3三 to guard against the opponent's rook attack. This completes the basic Gokigen Central Rook formation. From here the standard plan is to build a Mino castle and advance the silver to attack. Guarding with 3三角 is the same as in other Ranging Rook openings. You need to know the small variations leading up to this form, or you can end up worse right out of the opening.

section.ja: 5五の歩で角道を止めるのがポイント
section.en: Key point: block the bishop line with the 5五 pawn

title.ja: 図2-1 一見後手不利だが…
title.en: Figure 2-1: Looks bad for White at first, but...

explain.ja: この図1-1の形から、先手はいきなり角交換をする手があります。先手はすぐに馬を作れそうに見えますが、後手にはここで切り返しの手があります。
explain.en: From this position Black can exchange bishops immediately. It looks as if Black can promote a horse right away, but White has a counter here.

section.ja: いきなり角交換された場合は?
section.en: What if the bishops are exchanged immediately?

title.ja: 図2-2 切り返しの角打ち

explain.ja: 切り返しの一手は△4二角と自陣に打つことです。先手が馬を作っても、すぐに角交換するしかなく、結果として後手が手得になります。相手の角にはうまく逃げる場所がありません。
explain.en: The counter is to drop the bishop on 4二 with △4二角. Even if Black makes a horse, Black has to trade bishops right away, which leaves White ahead in tempo. Black's bishop has no good square to escape to.

section.ja: いきなり角交換された場合は?
section.en: What if the bishops are exchanged immediately?

title.ja: 図a-1 一見すると同じ局面だが…
title.en: Figure a-1: Looks like the same position, but...

explain.ja: この△4二角の切り返しは後手番でしか成り立ちません。例えば中飛車側が先手だった場合、同じように自陣に角を打ち込んでも、相手にうまい指し手があります。
explain.en: This △4二角 counter works only for White. If the Central Rook side were Black, dropping the bishop into one's own camp in the same way would be met by a good reply from the opponent.

section.ja: いきなり角交換された場合は?
section.en: What if the bishops are exchanged immediately?

title.ja: 図a-2 馬を作るスペースがある
title.en: Figure a-2: There is space to make a horse

explain.ja: 中飛車側が先手だと、相手は△8四角成と馬を作れます。これは、相手が飛車先の歩を突いていないために生じる変化です。先手番でゴキゲン中飛車を指したい場合は、最初に端歩を突くなどして1手調整する必要があります。
explain.en: With the Central Rook side as Black, the opponent can play △8四角成 and make a horse. This arises because the opponent has not pushed the rook-file pawn. To play Gokigen Central Rook as Black, you need to adjust by one move first, for example by pushing an edge pawn.

section.ja: いきなり角交換された場合は?
section.en: What if the bishops are exchanged immediately?

title.ja: 図2-3 相手が飛車先の歩を切ってきた
title.en: Figure 2-3: The opponent cut off the rook-file pawn

explain.ja: 図1-2の形から、相手が飛車先の歩を切ってきました。ここでも中飛車側には攻め合いに持ち込む手があります。このままだと相手に龍を作られてしまいそうですが、どう指すか考えてみましょう。
explain.en: From this position the opponent has captured on the rook file with the pawn. The Central Rook side again has a counterattacking resource. Left alone, the opponent would make a dragon, so think about what move to play.

section.ja: 飛車先を突破された場合の対処法
section.en: How to deal when the rook pawn is broken through

title.ja: 図2-4 飛車銀両取りに
title.en: Figure 2-4: Fork on rook and silver

explain.ja: 角交換して△3三角と打てば、飛車と角の両取り(fork)になります。この手筋は頻出なのでぜひ覚えましょう。相手が構わず▲2一飛成としてきたら、こちらも△8八角成と攻め合います。その後△2二飛などと飛車をぶつけて龍を消しにいけば十分です。
explain.en: Exchange bishops and drop the bishop on 3三 with △3三角, which forks the rook and bishop. This tesuji appears often, so remember it. If the opponent ignores it and plays ▲2一飛成, answer with △8八角成 and race. Following up with a rook such as △2二飛 to challenge and remove the dragon is enough.

section.ja: 飛車先を突破された場合の対処法
section.en: How to deal when the rook pawn is broken through

title.ja: 図2-5 垂らしの歩が手筋
title.en: Figure 2-5: The dangling pawn is the tesuji

explain.ja: 図2-4から相手が飛車を引いたら、△2六歩と歩を垂らすのが手筋です。▲同飛と歩を取ってきたら、もちろん△8八角成として銀を取りにいきます。
explain.en: If the opponent retreats the rook from this position, the tesuji is to drop a pawn with △2六歩. If Black captures with ▲同飛, of course play △8八角成 and go after the silver.

section.ja: 飛車先を突破された場合の対処法
section.en: How to deal when the rook pawn is broken through

title.ja: 図2-6 次の歩成が楽しみな局面
title.en: Figure 2-6: A position looking forward to the next pawn promotion

explain.ja: 図2-5からは△2二飛と回り、次の歩成を狙います。相手は▲3八銀などと受けに回るでしょうが、そこからじっくり駒組みをするだけでも優勢です。
explain.en: From here swing the rook with △2二飛 and aim for a pawn promotion next. The opponent will probably defend with something like ▲3八銀, but even just building up your position patiently afterward leaves you better.

section.ja: 飛車先を突破された場合の対処法
section.en: How to deal when the rook pawn is broken through

explain.ja: 図b-1のように、こちらが角道を止めた後に相手が飛車先を切ってきた場合は、先ほどの角交換から△3三角と打つ手順は指せません。この図b-1の手順は超急戦と呼ばれ、中飛車側がはっきり良くなる手順はなく、互角の戦いになります。
explain.en: As in this diagram, if you have blocked the bishop diagonal and the opponent then captures on the rook file, the earlier bishop exchange followed by △3三角 is not available. This line is called Cho-Kyusen (super-sharp attack); there is no line that clearly favors the Central Rook side, and the game is even.

section.ja: 飛車先を突破された場合の対処法
section.en: How to deal when the rook pawn is broken through
